notes.title: Spring Into Madness Sale: The Test of Insanity
notes.notes:
🌸 Spring is here, and so is the chaos! [b]The Test of Insanity[/b] is crashing the [b]Steam Spring Sale[/b] with a mind-bending discount that’ll make your brain—and wallet—do a double take. If you’ve ever wanted to test your wits against puzzles that laugh in the face of logic, now’s the time to jump in!

[h2]Why You Can’t Miss This:[/h2]  
- [b]Twisted Challenges Await:[/b] From math that breaks calculators to word puzzles that twist your tongue, this game’s got it all.  
- [b]Squirrels Included:[/b] Because nothing says “spring” like cute, chaos-causing critters.  
- [b]Level 1 Survivor’s Club:[/b] Most don’t make it past the first stage—will you?  
- [b]Ridiculous Fun:[/b] Inspired by *The Impossible Quiz*, it’s a wild ride of “wait, what?” moments.  

[h2]Where to Lose Your Mind:[/h2]  
- [b]Steam (On Sale Now!):[/b] All 50 levels
- [b]Free Taste of Insanity:[/b] Try the web game demo on [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/938341]Newgrounds (10 levels)[/url]  

The Spring Sale won’t last forever, and neither will your sanity once you start. Grab *The Test of Insanity* at a special price, dive into the madness, and see how far you can get before the squirrels win. Share your meltdowns with #SpringInsanity—let’s go nuts together!

🌟 [b]Act Fast:[/b] Snag it now and prove your brain’s got what it takes!

notes.title: Unlock the Madness: Play The Test of Insanity Today!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Dive into the twisted world of The Test of Insanity by Big Nuts, where puzzles are weird, quizzes are quirky, and mini-games are downright bizarre. Whether you’re a genius, an influencer, or the person who just got fired, this game is designed to test your mental limits in ways you’ve never imagined.

Think you’re smart? Think again. From not-so-traditional math problems and weird word puzzles to trivia that’ll make you scratch your head and skill tests that are incredibly difficult, this game has it all. And yes, there are cute squirrels to argue with!
